verdict.rationale: The only documented natural-language input is the onboarding AI Form Builder, where the user describes a form and Lever generates it. That is a narrow, single-feature instance of acting on a natural-language command, not a general way to operate the product. Other AI features (Talent Fit matching, transcripts and summaries, interview-question generation) and the Automation Hub are not described as natural-language command interfaces. Missing for 10: a general natural-language or conversational command interface across the ATS (e.g. advancing, tagging, searching candidates or building reports by prompt), documentation of its scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With the AI Form Builder, just describe the form you need, and it's generated instantly
